newsitem.title: TURKEY: Freighter runs aground off Turkish Black Sea coast.
newsitem.headline: Freighter runs aground off Turkish Black Sea coast.

text.p: A Belize-flagged freighter ran aground off the Turkish Black Sea coast, Turkish port authorities told Reuters on Thursday.
The 1,590 gross tonne, "Northstar" vessel ran aground early on Wednesday morning after slipping at anchor during a storm off the port of Bartin, port authority chairman Ali Alper said.
The ship was not carrying any cargo, Alper said.
Although efforts to refloat the ship have not begun due to poor weather conditions, neither the ship nor the 12-member crew was in any danger, Alper said.
